Merchandising and Retail Club

Rules for Activities Conducted by MARC

  1. Submit all Expression of Interest (EOI) forms shared by MARC by the stated deadline. MARC will decline late requests.
  2. Check samples only during the announced times and at the designated location.
  3. Once a student places an order and MARC receives payment, the order is final.
  4. MARC will distribute merchandise in two or three announced slots, depending on the quantity. Students must collect their orders during the scheduled slots.
  5. In extraordinary circumstances, students may request a different collection slot from the MARC team.
  6. Students forfeit any merchandise they fail to collect within five days after the final scheduled collection slot.
  7. Only the student who paid for the merchandise may collect it.
  8. In exceptional circumstances, a student who cannot collect their order may ask a MARC team member to allow another student to collect it on their behalf.
